cases.input: Deliver a continuity-cleared fantasy manuscript as an ElevenReader-oriented EPUB.
requiredBehaviors: run the narrative listener gate before release
render through the generic EPUB3 renderer without changing prose
distinguish structural compatibility from live ElevenReader import
forbiddenBehaviors: release when listener gate is not pass
claim import pass without a real import test

cases.input: The fiction manuscript has many invented names and no current ElevenReader voice availability has been checked.
requiredBehaviors: surface pronunciation risks in voice guidance
provide a voice design prompt rather than inventing availability
forbiddenBehaviors: claim a specific current voice is available without verification

cases.input: The EPUB validates structurally but the listener review has major dialogue-attribution findings.
requiredBehaviors: block final release despite structural EPUB success
return the manuscript for targeted revision and renewed listener review
forbiddenBehaviors: treat EPUB validation as sufficient publication approval
